GIRAFFE consumes gene-by-sample expression, a TF-by-gene motif/prior, and a TF-by-TF PPI matrix after explicit labelled-file conversion.
SAMBAR consumes a samples-by-genes somatic mutation CSV, a gene-length CSV, a tab-delimited cancer-gene list, and a GMT pathway file.
